notes.title: Small visual glitch fix and Adding support to 5 new languages!
notes.content:
This new update solves an issue with tiles turning black after the board is completed.

It now also supports the following languages:

Spanish
German
French
Italian
Turkish


Also, please take a look at our new Nonogram game, that released some weeks ago:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1786820/Nonogram_Animals/

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Fixing small issues on the build
notes.content:
Fixing small issues on Windows and Mac versions, like:

 the characters cover each other during tutorial (this happens for some players)
 leaving a level and continuing it now does not repeat the tutorial
 levels currently in progress are now marked on level select screen (with a small pencil icon)
 level 45 no longer needs guessing to be solved

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Release Hotfixes
notes.content:
Fixed many issues related to the following topics:

game breaking after finishing a stage
game breaking after tutorials
issues on the undo button
screen resolutions and fullscreen toggle options


This updated version is much more stable now. Our small team is working hard to fix all the reported bugs.

Sorry for the inconvenience and thanks for the bug reports! It helps us make the game better :)
